thread.topic: application for admin in the climb server

posts.subject: application for admin in the climb server
posts.bodyHtml:
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
2) How old are you?
3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
10) Strengths
11) Weaknesses
12) Conclusion / Closing remark


1) My real name is Vassil and my ingame name is Xxeo[N].
2) im 17 years old born on 7th February 1998.
3) I want to join in the administrative team to help the people with the kz even more.
4) I have been playing on the servers from 1 month+.
5) My hobbies are to play video games go out with friends or if im too lazy some days just to lay in my bed and listenning to music.
6) Yes i think im mature enough to be admin in the server
7) I have been administrator in Gmod DarkRP servers , in minecraft servers and in CS 1.6 servers but not yet in CSGO servers.
[8)] Now when im in summer vacation i can play about 11 hours or even more and when i have school about 6-8 hours.
9) First i will mute User 1 for 600 min and warn him and if he continue to insult User 2 i will ban him for 1 day.
10) I am good with the words , I can communicate with people well , I am polite and very friendly person who like to talk with people about theier problems and then if i can to help them.
11) Some times i can rage a bit if i do smt stupid also i dont ahve very fluent english
12) I have 2117 stamm points and 12190 points for the rank need 20 more for rank SICK. I have headset and i cna use TS3


P.S sorry for no effects but im doing it from ingame browser 😄 😄 😄 😄 😄


!!! THANKS FOR YOUR TIME !!!

Anyway to be honest i dont think your Application is good also to ban someone for 1 day after one warning is a bit heavy in my opinion.
